name: com.cituna/cituna-mcp
description: Track how 7 AI engines cite your brand, daily, with live Google Search Console.

environmentVariables.description: Personal API key from the Cituna app: Integrations, then "Claude / MCP access", then Generate token. Looks like cituna_sk_...
environmentVariables.name: CITUNA_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Backend base URL. Defaults to https://cituna.com; set this only to point at a different backend.
environmentVariables.name: CITUNA_API_URL

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Connect with just your own personal API key — no full-workspace OAuth grant. The key authenticates as you and is revocable in the app. (You can also add this URL as an OAuth connector instead, which defaults to read-only and keeps Google Search Console a separate opt-in.)

apiKey.description: Your Cituna personal API key (cituna_sk_…). Create it in the app under Integrations → "Claude / MCP access" → Generate token. It is scoped to your workspace only and can be revoked at any time.
